component.name: Planet Time
component.summary: World clocks, alarms, stopwatch and timers

description.p: Planet Time shows your day across the globe on one dashboard: the time in the cities you care about, where they are on a world map, and what the weather and daylight are like there.

ul.li: World clocks with time differences, current weather and day or night at a glance
A dotted world map with your cities and their time zones
A home card with a living sky or a photo of your city, the moon phase, sunrise and sunset
Alarms that repeat on chosen days, with snooze, and keep ringing when the window is closed
Several timers at once, with quick presets and optional labels
Follows your system light or dark style and 12 or 24 hour clock setting

description.p: Weather comes from Open-Meteo and can be turned off in Preferences. A photo of your home city from Wikipedia is optional; the default living sky needs no internet.

screenshot.caption: The dashboard with world clocks, weather and the world map
